title: boostcamp_4_day_home_dumbbell_plan
author: giridhar.gp ggp
desc:
A simple 4-day dumbbell plan designed for home training.  
Build a consistent routine with focused sessions spread across the week.  
A one-week program that’s easy to fit around your schedule and repeat as needed.  
Grab your dumbbells and get started.

ex.note: Use a pair of dumbbells; controlled lowering
Brace hand on bench; keep torso steady
Sit upright on bench; stop before painful range
Lightest dumbbells; slight bend in elbows
Use one or two dumbbells; keep upper arms steady
Hold one dumbbell at chest; use controlled depth
Pair of dumbbells; hinge at hips, neutral back
Bodyweight is fine if balance is challenging
One dumbbell across hips; pad as needed
Pause briefly at the top
If bench is flat only, use flat dumbbell press
Lie face down on bench if incline adjustable; otherwise repeat one-arm row
One dumbbell; keep range comfortable
Light weight; hinge or lie face down on bench
Keep elbows near sides
Rear foot on bench; start bodyweight if needed
Hold one dumbbell; use bench lightly for balance
If unsafe or too high, substitute reverse lunge
One dumbbell across hips
Bodyweight core work; move slowly
